### Exact hardware
Manufacturer, model, board and chip identifiers; no serial numbers.

### Existing Linux evidence
Boot access, kernel/device tree, firmware sources, working and missing functions.

### Testing and recovery
Who can physically test? How can a failed installation be recovered?

### Scope
Explain the relationship to the reference OmniBook. A shared SoC is not proof of compatibility.
